_source: CORE ELA Pacing Guide Grade K - Beyond the Page, uploaded by Loren 8/29/26. Grade K's guide is a different shape from Grades 1-8: one book/unit per week rather than Mission/Topic/Lesson, so this file carries only cursive (absent) and gap_by_week, the two things the week-shift schema actually reads - the book/unit content itself is deliberately not shown in the week-shift panel, per Loren's direction: the panel shows the week range plus standards-gap and supplemental activities by name, the same shape as every other grade, and nothing else, even where that means a week with no gap activity renders as a bare week-range line. Gap activities: 15 of 36 weeks name one, all from the 'Visions Supplemental Lessons for Moving Beyond the Page - K' document (1ZiDCMYRnCe2CWGvhM-35JqI7n_79afdP-U0OeBs44Og), matched to Loren's uploaded PDF of that document by code and by the guide's own week-by-week order, which lines up 1:1 with the PDF's own worksheet order (all 15 PDF worksheets used exactly once). Two other documents were excluded from this file after Loren supplied the actual H-SS doc for comparison: weeks 8, 15, 31 and 35 additionally name activities from 1awmHSBif3E4f9HQmC4uCjOKsylQqrhiNvpxwADOE7UY (codes K-ESS2-2, K-PS2-2, PS3-1, PS3-2 - NGSS Science standards, despite the district's own link sheet mislabeling this document 'H-SS - Grade K') and 1z8nvZgFHsZRpiwumZufrgx788BQEQ-f_lmN91E6wTxQ (codes K.2, K.3 - genuine CA H-SS standards, matching the K.2/K.3/K.4 pattern used elsewhere in this guide's own 'History-Social Science' rows). Both are out of scope for the ELA week-shift file; they belong to Science and H-SS gap-activity data respectively, not covered here. One guide typo caught by elimination: week 18 names 'RF.K.3.c', which matches no worksheet in the PDF. Week 17 already accounts for RF.K.3.b (Marshmallow) - confirmed by Loren, since the code sits outside the week 17 link's markdown brackets and an earlier pass missed it - which leaves RF.K.3.d (Umbrella) as the only unused worksheet for week 18, also confirmed by Loren directly from the PDF's own stated standard. Recorded as RF.K.3.d, not the guide's literal RF.K.3.c. Weeks 1, 3, 15, and 19-36 name no ELA gap activity in the guide.
